findings.finding: The committed census records this route's destination as not recorded BECAUSE the held compiled presentation does not establish it, and records a held route-presentation conflict with the compiled text described as conflated.
findings.consequence: The packet states the destination as not recorded, names the clerk's office of the court that entered the first-offender sentence as the authority, and does not read a destination out of compiled text the census itself records as conflated. Reading one out anyway is exactly the sibling-route inference DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A3 forbids.

findings.finding: The compiled Georgia pathway for this route carries text about O.C.G.A. § 42-8-66 retroactive first-offender treatment alongside the § 42-8-62.1 material.
findings.consequence: Nothing keyed to § 42-8-66 is used as this route's answer. § 42-8-66 is a separate route with its own family in this same lane, and its first step is a prosecutor's written consent rather than a filing.
